753:t_073:18.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I entrust that strength to you, together with the feelings of everyone.」

753:t_073:21.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ラクス$$... So you're fighting too.」

$$ＡＧ$$

(Master... So you and the $$ガランシェール$$ team are fighting too.)

753:t_014:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone. I'm ashamed to say it, but what remains of the $$サイデリアル$$... has come to lend you a hand.」

753:t_014:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Leave the enemies around us to us!」

753:t_014:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Please bring down the center of the distortion!」

753:t_014:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! $$ダバラーン$$ and $$尸刻$$ too!」

753:t_014:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「This is Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$新地球連邦軍$$.」

753:t_014:7.en:
$$カティ$$
「We'll give everything we have to back up $c! So don't give up hope!」

753:t_014:8.en:
$$イザーク$$
「Leave the defense of Earth to us!」

753:t_014:9.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「So we're counting on you at the front!」

753:t_014:10.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$イザーク$$! $$ディアッカ$$ too!」

753:t_014:11.en:
$$イズモ$$
「The $$アルテア$$ army will join the fight too! Fight until the very last moment!」

753:t_014:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Old man $$イズモ$$ came here too!?」

753:t_014:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No, $$カグラ$$. That's our dad.」

753:t_014:16.en:
$$ヘンケン$$
「Nobody on our side has given up either!」

753:t_014:17.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Our strength is slight, but if we bind it together, it should become a great force!」

753:t_014:23.en:

「...You would throw away your lives rather than wait for the great collapse...? Very well. That is fine too.」

753:t_015:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn! Those monsters are heading for the reinforcements!」

753:t_015:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's the $$御使い$$s' forces! Regular units that haven't achieved $$真化融合$$ don't stand a chance!」

753:t_015:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're sacrificing themselves to save us...」

753:t_015:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They were driven to desperation when the barrier protecting Earth disappeared, weren't they...」

753:t_015:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...What a tragedy. Because you keep up your pointless resistance, needless suffering is born.」

753:t_015:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In only a few more minutes, everything will vanish... You could simply meet the final moment with a quiet heart, and yet... It's far too sad.」

753:t_015:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Don't decide on your own that they're sacrifices.」

753:t_015:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They are fighting with pride! Doing everything you can to live is the duty of every living being!」

753:t_015:8.en:
$n
「No one... has given up! Not us, and not anyone else!」

753:t_015:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「And that's not just the ones standing on the battlefield!」

753:t_015:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Now let's show you the true strength of humanity!」

753:t_016:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right... It's the light in the hearts of people all over Earth.」

753:t_016:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$スヴェル$$ didn't run out of time... Apparently the people of Earth decided on their own to release it, to save their last strength.」

753:t_016:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「They did it to entrust $c with their feelings and the power of their lives!」

753:t_017:8.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$, $$沙慈$$...)

753:t_017:11.en:
$$バサラ$$
「This is one hell of a soul!」

753:t_017:12.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Of course! It's the life force of every single person on Earth!」

753:t_018:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Let's sing too, with everything we've got!」

753:t_019:0.en:
$$大杉$$
「We can't let ourselves lose either!」

753:t_019:1.en:
$$大山$$
「Let's have them carry our feelings along too!」

753:t_020:1.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Yeah! I'm sure $$バナージ$$ and the others will turn our wishes into strength too!」

753:t_021:0.en:
$$チェーン$$
「The $$サイコ・フレーム$$... the GN particles, the Fold Quartz, the $$Ｚクリスタル$$s... They're all gathering people's will.」

753:t_021:1.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「The machines of $c have the mechanics' will fused into them too!」

753:t_022:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hang in there, everyone!! We're here too!」

753:t_023:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I feel it... This isn't only the feelings of the living.」

753:t_023:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The souls of people we knew have come here too.」

753:t_023:2.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Understood, Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$! We'll show you the pride and grit of $$エコーズ$$!」

753:t_023:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Thanks, $$キタン$$! I'll add your power to mine and slam it into him!」

753:t_023:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ロックオン$$...! I will change... and I will make the world change!」

753:t_023:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood, Major $$カリーニン$$! I... Ikimasu!」

753:t_023:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Forgive me, everyone... You're lending your strength to a man like me...」

753:t_023:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「The souls of everyone in the $$黒の騎士団$$! I'll carry them!」

753:t_024:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand, $$レナード$$... You can't forgive his existence either, can you.」

753:t_024:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$ソフィア$$... Even without whispers from the future, we'll win the future we want with our own strength!)

753:t_025:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Leave it to me, $$グラハム・エーカー$$!」
